reason: The first eight proposals describe the same 16-call panel32 wrapper experiment, so they are one hypothesis, not independent evidence. Rank that experiment first: the helper has passed panel ABI checks, and the fresh augmented baseline scored about 1035–1071 GFLOP/s, but no panel-wrapper performance is measured; sixteen calls and SME transitions add risk. The B-panel proposal has unresolved layout compatibility and adds a full-matrix copy. Tail alignment does not affect the n=512 timed path. Historical scheduling candidates did not pass promotion gates and do not support repeating schedule changes.
